assembly_notes: A laser level tripod is one shared frame host (yellow die-cast crown/hub, central plumb column, sliding spreader collar, head seat) carrying N=3 indexed leg units and one instrument head. Every leg hinges outward from a crown bracket via a registered REVOLUTE about a horizontal tangential axis (-sin a, cos a, 0); the telescoping candidate adds a PRISMATIC lower segment sliding along the leg axis. The head pans about the vertical crown axis (0,0,1): pan_disk is a bounded REVOLUTE, pan_drum is CONTINUOUS. Leg azimuths are -pi/2 + 2*pi*i/N so the three legs occupy disjoint 120-degree sectors and cannot intersect one another over the full spread range. Head seat height, leg direction, foot drop and telescope junction/travel are all derived from overall_scale and leg_spread_deploy before geometry emission. All five structural slots combine freely (core_domain = 2*2*2*2*2 = 32) with no compatibility gate; every combination is built and author-checked. center_column (plumb_hook | plumb_rod) is emitted entirely onto the shared frame host and head_mount (stud_disk | qr_platform) entirely onto the rotating head part, so their seams are intra-part and free; foot (rubber_pad | molded_boot) is emitted onto whichever part carries the leg tip -- the one-piece leg for `fixed`, the sliding lower tube for `telescoping` -- and both candidates place their lowest surface at the same leg-local offset 0.016 * overall_scale, so the grounded-neutral-pose invariant holds for all of them. N is source-anchored at 3. Cross-component derivations formerly written as bindings are recorded here because both endpoints hang off the shared non-slotted `frame` host, which is not a declared component slot: frame_to_head_pan: frame.head_seat_axis -> head.pan_axis (revolute_or_continuous); head_seat_z = crown_stack_height * overall_scale | frame_to_leg_spread: frame.hinge_axis_i -> leg_structure.spread_axis (revolute); hinge_point_i = (hinge_radius*cos(a_i), hinge_radius*sin(a_i), hinge_z); a_i = -pi/2 + 2*pi*i/leg_count | leg_upper_to_lower_telescope: leg_structure.telescope_junction -> leg_structure.lower_segment (prismatic); telescope_travel = 0.11 * overall_scale * telescope_travel_scale
